name: PEKPIK LLM
description: An unofficial model gateway with manually claimed daily credit.
overview: The operator advertises $1 on email verification, then $0.50 per daily manual claim, continuing after the initial $20 campaign. Claims reset the balance rather than stack, so skipped or unused credit lapses. Its approximate 1.85M deepseek-chat input tokens is a price conversion, not an input-plus-output grant. Free model eligibility, billing and branded model identities were not independently tested.

privacy.label: Gateway; privacy and model identity unverified

free_access: Token estimates depend on model prices
notes: Base URL https://aiapiv2.pekpik.com/v1. Check available free models and current billing before use; do not send sensitive data.
